edges.notes: XT60 pair and tail taped on the skin (foam tape) and tied
harness lump: ties and tape on the wing
pack lead XT60 male mated to the ESC-side XT60 female (disconnect); both lead pairs run outboard of the plate
14 AWG tail from the XT60 female to the ESC battery pads (flat pair, inboard over the ESC)

motor phase leads UR (3 x 20 AWG, OD 1.8 mm, V T-Motor / Pimoroni): out of the motor base through the cup lead hole into the cup collar, inside the arm bore to the hub end, out through the socket floor hole, then exposed over the hub and wing (D-198) to the ESC pad

support_points: tie at the hub aft face
wire.strain_relief: heat-shrink + tie at the floor hole

edges.notes: ESC lead to the FC (VBAT, signals, telemetry): 6 conductors, soldered to the FC pads (the Kakute has pads, not sockets: docs.holybro.com pinout 2026-11-15)
servo lead R: 3-conductor ribbon, soldered to the FC pad M5/M6 (JR plug cut off; the FC has pads only), laid on the skin to the servo
servo lead L: 3-conductor ribbon, soldered to the FC pad M5/M6 (JR plug cut off; the FC has pads only), laid on the skin to the servo
RX UART (CRSF wire soldered at the RX pads) lead
GPS (plug on the GPS board, other end soldered to the FC) lead
airspeed I2C (plug on the MS4525 board, other end soldered to the FC) lead
